detection.filter: Butterworth high-pass, causal, started settled at the first sample
detection.criterion: det-v1: local maxima of the RMS over a 5 ms detection window of the signal high-passed at 100 Hz (4th-order Butterworth high-pass, causal, started settled at the first sample), evaluated 1000 times per second, at least 14 dB above the noise baseline; of peaks closer than 0.25 s only the highest is kept. Baseline: median detection level of the latest noise-only trial at or before the trial (any noise-only trial if none precedes it), skipping its first 1 s; else the quietest 2 s of the trial.
